headline: NIFTY Bank surges on strong quarterly earnings
text: NIFTY Bank index rallied 2.5% today after major banks reported better-than-expected quarterly profits. HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank led the gains with strong loan growth.

headline: IT sector faces headwinds from global slowdown
text: NIFTY IT declined 1.2% as concerns over global tech spending slowdown weighed on sentiment. Infosys and TCS saw selling pressure.

headline: FMCG stocks gain on rural demand recovery
text: NIFTY FMCG rose 1.8% on signs of rural demand pickup. HUL and Nestle reported strong volume growth in Q3.

headline: Pharma sector rallies on FDA approvals
text: NIFTY Pharma jumped 3.1% after multiple companies received FDA approvals for new drugs. Sun Pharma and Dr Reddy's led the rally.

headline: Auto sector under pressure from high fuel costs
text: NIFTY Auto fell 0.8% as rising fuel prices dampened consumer sentiment. Maruti and Tata Motors saw profit booking.

headline: Energy stocks surge on Brent crude rally
text: NIFTY Energy gained 2.3% as Brent crude prices jumped 5% on supply concerns. Reliance and ONGC were top gainers.

headline: Metal stocks decline on China demand worries
text: NIFTY Metal dropped 1.5% on concerns over slowing Chinese demand. Tata Steel and JSW Steel saw selling pressure.

headline: Realty sector gains on policy support hopes
text: NIFTY Realty rose 1.2% on expectations of government policy support for affordable housing. DLF and Godrej Properties gained.

headline: Banking sector continues strong momentum
text: NIFTY Bank extended gains with another 1.5% rise. Strong credit growth and improving asset quality boosted sentiment across private and PSU banks.

headline: IT sector recovers on positive guidance
text: NIFTY IT rebounded 1.8% after major IT companies provided positive guidance for next quarter. TCS and Infosys led the recovery.
